organiser.name: Aotearoa Surf Film Festival (run by Louis Murphy-Harris; founded by filmmaker Nick Stevenson)

attendance.note: Organiser-reported: '26 shows across 12 weeks, reaching 5000+ people'. Page is undated but matches the 2026 tour format (12 weeks, 26 communities). FilmFreeway listing also gives audience attendance 5,000. The free Takapuna outdoor screening draws '2000+'.

add_sources.note: Festival Partners page (crawled Oct 2026): Patagonia (presents Most Environmentally Conscious Film award), Sawmill Brewery (tour partner, presents Best Film Soundtrack), YETI (presents People's Choice), Sol + Sea, Pals, Good Surf Now!, Verdure, SurfShell (tour partners), Sticky Johnson (supporting partner).
Apr 2026: Patagonia 'back to the ASFF whanau for the fourth year running' (so 2023 to 2026).
Feb 2026 programme post thanks sponsors: Red Bull, Patagonia, YETI, Sawmill, Sol + Sea, Verdure, Good Surf Now, Pals, SurfShell, Sticky Johnson.
Apr 2026 Auckland finale sponsor shoutout adds Mt Atkinson Coffee; 'heaps of sponsored spot prizes'.
Google snippet: 2024 tour partners 'Red Bull, Patagonia, Canon New Zealand, Good Surf Now ...'.
Google snippet: "Photo Warehouse 'Best Kiwi Film, Presented by ...'"; year not shown.
Page names 'The O'Neill Aotearoa Surf Film Festival', 'back for its 8th year'. Festival launched 2013 and 2026 was the 14th, so the 8th was 2020.
Sawmill beers sold at all ASFF shows; Pals likewise (https://www.instagram.com/p/DWW7wGekqDA/). Award sponsorships and Verdure custom-board draw (https://www.instagram.com/p/DWDUCXOEkS5/).
About page: 'ASFF hosts 26 shows across 12 weeks, reaching 5000+ people'.
Founded by filmmaker Nick Stevenson; 'Louis Murphy-Harris has since taken over the reins of the festival'.
Contact page has a form only; louis@asff.co.nz is the FilmFreeway festival contact.

notes: Strong outdoor and surf brand roster for 2026 (Patagonia, YETI, Red Bull, Sawmill, Pals) plus Sol + Sea sunscreen as a wellness-adjacent tour partner. O'Neill naming pinned to 2020 by edition count and is absent from the 2026 partner list, so it looks historical; orchestrator may want to drop the 'naming' role for current editions. Sponsors present awards and spot prizes; no paid-partnership posts.
